title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress
abstract: arXiv:2610.14146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. translated_title: 长时程终端基准 2.0：自动化多样化任务构建与衡量智能体的持续进展能力
translated_abstract: 长时程终端基准用于衡量智能体能否在扩展的工作流程中通过过程奖励保持持续进展，而不仅仅是其最终状态是否通过二元检查。我们提出了长时程终端基准 2.0（LHTB 2.0），它是 Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 的扩展版本，在保留其原有46个任务的同时，修正了任务和评估基础设施中的缺陷，并扩展了31个任务。LHTB 2.0 包含覆盖13个领域、八种任务类型的77个任务。扩展任务通过系统化的任务重建流水线生成：我们从一个可正常工作的科学或工程制品出发，使用参数化的参考实现生成多个场景，其中六个场景作为行为证据展示，三个场景保留用于评估，并采用密集的进度阶梯机制来奖励部分进展，同时防止对公开输出的死记硬背。我们还将评估时间范围从90分钟延长至三小时，并记录……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: LHTB 2.0 通过系统化的任务重建流水线与密集进度阶梯奖励机制，将长时程终端基准扩展为覆盖13个领域的77个任务，并将评估时长延长至三小时，以更全面地衡量智能体在长时程工作流中的持续进展能力。
en_tdlr: LHTB 2.0 extends the long-horizon terminal benchmark to 77 tasks across 13 domains through a systematic task-reconstruction pipeline and dense progress ladders, with evaluation horizons extended to three hours to measure sustained agent progress.
